lessonTitle: 1. The notion of a numerical function
lessonTitleEnglish: The notion of a numerical function
unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Properties of numerical functions
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: If every x in a set X has exactly one y assigned, a numerical function y = f(x) is given on X; X is the domain.
stages.headlineEnglish: If every x in a set X has exactly one y assigned, a numerical function y = f(x) is given on X; X is the domain.

stages.headline: To find the domain, exclude x values where the formula makes no sense: division by zero or a root of a negative number.
stages.headlineEnglish: To find the domain, exclude x values where the formula makes no sense: division by zero or a root of a negative number.

stages.headline: The graph of a function is the set of points (x; f(x)) of the coordinate plane.
stages.headlineEnglish: The graph of a function is the set of points (x; f(x)) of the coordinate plane.
